grouping_rule.sample_size_rule: explicit frame counts are not evidence of independence; report number of groups, positives, negatives, viewpoints and conditions

data_budget_next_experiment.total_frames_target: 200-400 across groups, not 200-400 random consecutive frames
data_budget_next_experiment.annotation_target: bbox + one green-light keypoint for every target-positive sampled frame; negatives empty; visibility/truncation flags
data_budget_next_experiment.sampling: fixed time/path intervals; no score-based selection
data_budget_next_experiment.gui_required: foreground visible Isaac Sim GUI DirectX/D3D12 if new capture is needed; no headless
